notes.title: Map Contest Special: Escape Mode!
notes.content:
[img]http://w4.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_555f10b40420c.jpeg?d02b67fe5adb0[/img]

[i]Have you ever wondered what makes a map famous? Well, it has to be super cool, of course, but it also needs to be visible. Good thing is, the new Escape Mode barely has any map yet, so any new creation will get a very special chance to shine.[/i]

If you want your talent to be recognized and your name to be remembered by every Brick-Force player, we have the opportunity you’ve been waiting for, introducing…

[b]The Escape Mode Map Building Contest![/b]

[h1]How to participate?[/h1]

It is very simple:

[*]Create your own awesome Escape Mode Map! IT HAS to include the new “Escape Brick”! Don’t hesitate to create crazy labyrinths!
[*][url=http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/30721-Map-Contest-Special-Escape-Mode]Post pictures or a video of it in the Contest Thread on the forums before Sunday the 31st of May.[/url][/list]

The winners will be announced the following weeks.

[h1]What prizes can I win?[/h1]

[*]1st Place: 3000 Tokens + A Weapon of your choice!
[*]2nd Place: 2500 Tokens
[*]3rd Place : 2000 Tokens

+ Eternal fame within the Brick-Force Community, of course!

[/list]Do not forget to read the [url=http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/26688-General-Contest-Rules]Map Contests rules[/url] before you participate; they apply to this contest as well!
